description: Reviewed baseline for CROCO_STATIC_EMPTY_CATCH_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY. New production empty catch blocks must be converted or added with package/file/reason and owner and unexpired expiresOn metadata.

entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-09-16: optional telemetry event callbacks must not interrupt remaining invalidations or replace successful cache results. CacheInvalidationGraph.spec.ts verifies both operations complete when each callback throws; no independent non-throwing diagnostic sink exists.

Reviewed 2026-09-16: optional telemetry error callbacks must not replace the original adapter Problem or its cause. CacheInvalidationGraph.spec.ts verifies the exact reported Problem is rejected with its original adapter cause when reporting throws; no independent non-throwing diagnostic sink exists.
Runtime inspector failure reporters are optional instrumentation and must not affect application behavior.

Reviewed 2026-10-16: analytics capture runs after completeStep persists state. OnboardingManager.spec.ts verifies throwing capture cannot reject committed completion, prevent later analytics events, or emit duplicate completion on retry; the manager has no independent diagnostic sink.

Reviewed 2026-10-16: the optional error logger must not replace a committed after-hook failure or stop later hooks. testing.spec.ts verifies a throwing logger preserves the original Problem as the aggregate cause, committed=true, and subsequent hook execution; logging recursively has no safe independent sink.
Startup logging is optional and must not prevent the GraphQL server from resolving a successful listen callback.

Reviewed 2026-09-29: response body drain failures must not replace the already-determined webhook status (derived from response.ok/status before the drain). The body is discarded, not interpreted, and the adapter has no diagnostic sink; WebhookLifecycleActionAdapter.spec.ts covers body consumption on both branches.
